issues.description: Import grouping: no blank line between standard library import (import os) and third-party imports (from conan import ...). Code style rule 16 requires a blank line between import groups (stdlib → third-party → project internal).
issues.fix_suggestion: Add a blank line after `import os` and before `from conan import ConanFile` to separate stdlib and third-party import groups.

issues.description: manifest.yaml uses field name `software:` instead of `name:` as specified in code style rule 14 example (which shows `name: zlib`).
issues.fix_suggestion: Rename `software:` to `name:` to match the code style rule 14 format, or confirm with project maintainers if `software:` is the accepted field name.

issues.description: manifest.yaml `version: 1.07.1` is unquoted. Code style rule 14 example shows `version: "1.3.1"` with double quotes for string values.
issues.fix_suggestion: Add double quotes: `version: "1.07.1"` to match the code style rule 14 format.
